title: States of matter: topic test
description: A 25-minute test on the whole States of matter topic (Solids, liquids and gases; Diffusion): 12 questions, 20 marks, from quick recall to an exam-style question. Questions are drawn at random from the question bank, so every attempt is different. It includes Supplement content (examined only on the Extended papers 2 and 4), so Core candidates will meet some questions beyond their syllabus.
instructions:
Answer every question. You have 25 minutes.

- Use the correct chemical terms and formulae, balance equations, and give units with numerical answers.
- Multiple-choice, true/false, numerical and most short answers are marked automatically when you submit.
- Written explanations cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer.

sections.instructions: These questions are worth 4 and 6 marks. Use the marks as a guide to how many separate points to make.
